reason: The context-switching pain is real — I run three AI agents a day and re-explaining context kills me — and $30 with five free seats is affordable. But I'm not handing my agents, credentials, and session data to a day-one daemon from a vendor with no track record, and I can't force my team onto one agent anyway.
objection: I don't trust an unknown vendor with my code, credentials, and session data — no audit, no reputation, no one I know vouching for it, and it's a pre-sale pilot, not a proven tool.
would_change_my_mind: A third-party security audit, public source or self-host option, and an engineering lead I already trust vouching for it, plus a free trial my team can test before paying.
